namespace App\Payments;

use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\PaymentGatewayException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Assert;

final class FakePaymentGateway implements PaymentGateway
{
    /** @var array<string, array{amount: int, token: string, charge: GatewayCharge}> */
    private array $chargesByKey = [];

    /** @var array<string, array{charge: string, amount: int, refund: GatewayRefund}> */
    private array $refundsByKey = [];

    private bool $failNextRefund = false;

    public function charge(int $amountCents, string $token, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayCharge
    {
        if ($seen = $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['amount'] !== $amountCents || $seen['token'] !== $token) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['charge'];
        }

        $charge = new GatewayCharge('ch_'.Str::random(14), $amountCents);
        $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['amount' => $amountCents, 'token' => $token, 'charge' => $charge];

        return $charge;
    }

    public function refund(string $chargeId, int $amountCents, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayRefund
    {
        if ($seen = $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['charge'] !== $chargeId || $seen['amount'] !== $amountCents) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['refund'];
        }

        if ($this->failNextRefund) {
            $this->failNextRefund = false;

            throw new PaymentGatewayException('The payment provider is unavailable.');
        }

        $refund = new GatewayRefund('re_'.Str::random(14), $chargeId, $amountCents);
        $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['charge' => $chargeId, 'amount' => $amountCents, 'refund' => $refund];

        return $refund;
    }

    public function failNextRefund(): void
    {
        $this->failNextRefund = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayCharge>
     */
    public function charges(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['charge'], $this->chargesByKey));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsFor(string $chargeId): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->chargeId === $chargeId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsByKey(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey);
    }

    public function assertRefunded(string $chargeId, int $amountCents): void
    {
        $matching = array_filter(
            $this->refundsFor($chargeId),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->amount === $amountCents,
        );

        Assert::assertNotEmpty($matching, "No refund of [{$amountCents}] was issued for charge [{$chargeId}].");
    }

    public function assertNothingRefunded(): void
    {
        Assert::assertEmpty($this->refundsByKey, 'Unexpected refunds were issued.');
    }
}

namespace App\Payments;

use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\PaymentGatewayException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Assert;

final class FakePaymentGateway implements PaymentGateway
{
    /** @var array<string, array{amount: int, token: string, charge: GatewayCharge}> */
    private array $chargesByKey = [];

    /** @var array<string, array{charge: string, amount: int, refund: GatewayRefund}> */
    private array $refundsByKey = [];

    private bool $failNextRefund = false;

    public function charge(int $amountCents, string $token, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayCharge
    {
        if ($seen = $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['amount'] !== $amountCents || $seen['token'] !== $token) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['charge'];
        }

        $charge = new GatewayCharge('ch_'.Str::random(14), $amountCents);
        $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['amount' => $amountCents, 'token' => $token, 'charge' => $charge];

        return $charge;
    }

    public function refund(string $chargeId, int $amountCents, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayRefund
    {
        if ($seen = $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['charge'] !== $chargeId || $seen['amount'] !== $amountCents) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['refund'];
        }

        if ($this->failNextRefund) {
            $this->failNextRefund = false;

            throw new PaymentGatewayException('The payment provider is unavailable.');
        }

        $refund = new GatewayRefund('re_'.Str::random(14), $chargeId, $amountCents);
        $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['charge' => $chargeId, 'amount' => $amountCents, 'refund' => $refund];

        return $refund;
    }

    public function failNextRefund(): void
    {
        $this->failNextRefund = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayCharge>
     */
    public function charges(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['charge'], $this->chargesByKey));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsFor(string $chargeId): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->chargeId === $chargeId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsByKey(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey);
    }

    public function assertRefunded(string $chargeId, int $amountCents): void
    {
        $matching = array_filter(
            $this->refundsFor($chargeId),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->amount === $amountCents,
        );

        Assert::assertNotEmpty($matching, "No refund of [{$amountCents}] was issued for charge [{$chargeId}].");
    }

    public function assertNothingRefunded(): void
    {
        Assert::assertEmpty($this->refundsByKey, 'Unexpected refunds were issued.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Orders;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordAuditEntry;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Payments\PaymentGateway;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Charges the customer and creates a paid order.
 *
 * Retrying with the same checkout key returns the order created by the first attempt.
 */
final class PlaceOrder
{
    public function __construct(
        private PaymentGateway $gateway,
        private RecordAuditEntry $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(User $customer, int $amount, string $paymentToken, string $checkoutKey): Order
    {
        if ($existing = $customer->orders()->firstWhere('checkout_key', $checkoutKey)) {
            return $existing;
        }

        $charge = $this->gateway->charge($amount, $paymentToken, "checkout-{$checkoutKey}");

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($customer, $amount, $checkoutKey, $charge) {
            $order = $customer->orders()->create([
                'amount' => $amount,
                'status' => OrderStatus::Paid,
                'gateway_charge_id' => $charge->id,
                'checkout_key' => $checkoutKey,
                'paid_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->audit->handle($customer, 'order.placed', $order, [
                'amount' => $amount,
                'gateway_charge_id' => $charge->id,
            ]);

            return $order;
        });
    }
}

namespace App\Payments;

use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\PaymentGatewayException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Assert;

final class FakePaymentGateway implements PaymentGateway
{
    /** @var array<string, array{amount: int, token: string, charge: GatewayCharge}> */
    private array $chargesByKey = [];

    /** @var array<string, array{charge: string, amount: int, refund: GatewayRefund}> */
    private array $refundsByKey = [];

    private bool $failNextRefund = false;

    public function charge(int $amountCents, string $token, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayCharge
    {
        if ($seen = $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['amount'] !== $amountCents || $seen['token'] !== $token) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['charge'];
        }

        $charge = new GatewayCharge('ch_'.Str::random(14), $amountCents);
        $this->chargesByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['amount' => $amountCents, 'token' => $token, 'charge' => $charge];

        return $charge;
    }

    public function refund(string $chargeId, int $amountCents, string $idempotencyKey): GatewayRefund
    {
        if ($seen = $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] ?? null) {
            if ($seen['charge'] !== $chargeId || $seen['amount'] !== $amountCents) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $seen['refund'];
        }

        if ($this->failNextRefund) {
            $this->failNextRefund = false;

            throw new PaymentGatewayException('The payment provider is unavailable.');
        }

        $refund = new GatewayRefund('re_'.Str::random(14), $chargeId, $amountCents);
        $this->refundsByKey[$idempotencyKey] = ['charge' => $chargeId, 'amount' => $amountCents, 'refund' => $refund];

        return $refund;
    }

    public function failNextRefund(): void
    {
        $this->failNextRefund = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayCharge>
     */
    public function charges(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['charge'], $this->chargesByKey));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsFor(string $chargeId): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->chargeId === $chargeId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, GatewayRefund>
     */
    public function refundsByKey(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (array $entry) => $entry['refund'], $this->refundsByKey);
    }

    public function assertRefunded(string $chargeId, int $amountCents): void
    {
        $matching = array_filter(
            $this->refundsFor($chargeId),
            fn (GatewayRefund $refund) => $refund->amount === $amountCents,
        );

        Assert::assertNotEmpty($matching, "No refund of [{$amountCents}] was issued for charge [{$chargeId}].");
    }

    public function assertNothingRefunded(): void
    {
        Assert::assertEmpty($this->refundsByKey, 'Unexpected refunds were issued.');
    }
}

    }

    public function cancel(User $user, Order $order): bool

    public function refund(User $user, Order $order): bool
    {

            && $order->status === OrderStatus::Paid;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Refunds;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordAuditEntry;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Events\OrderRefunded;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Refund;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use App\Payments\PaymentGateway;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Refunds part of a paid order, possibly in several steps, up to the order amount.
 *
 * Authorization (OrderPolicy::refund) is the caller's job, as for the other Actions.
 *
 * @contract docs/contracts/refunds.partial.md
 */
final class RefundOrderPartially
{
    public function __construct(
        private PaymentGateway $gateway,
        private RecordAuditEntry $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  int  $amount  cents
     *
     * @throws ValidationException when the amount is not positive or exceeds the refundable balance
     * @throws IdempotencyKeyReused when the key was already used on this order with another amount
     */
    public function handle(Order $order, User $actor, int $amount, string $reason, string $idempotencyKey): Refund
    {
        // REFUND-INV-5: a replay returns the refund already recorded, without writing anything.
        if ($existing = $order->refunds()->firstWhere('idempotency_key', $idempotencyKey)) {
            if ($existing->amountInCents() !== $amount) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $existing;
        }

        // REFUND-INV-2: never beyond the refundable balance, checked before the gateway.
        $refundable = $order->refundableCents();

        if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $refundable) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'amount' => "L'importo deve essere compreso fra 1 e {$refundable} centesimi.",
            ]);
        }

        // Before the transaction, with the client's key as is (REFUND-INV-5).
        $result = $this->gateway->refund($order->gateway_charge_id, $amount, $idempotencyKey);

        $refund = DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $actor, $amount, $reason, $idempotencyKey, $result) {
            $refund = $order->refunds()->create([
                'amount' => Refund::centsToEuros($amount),
                'gateway_refund_id' => $result->id,
                'refunded_by' => $actor->id,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
            ]);

            // ORDER-INV-1, compared in cents.
            $order->update([
                'status' => $order->refundedCents() >= $order->amount
                    ? OrderStatus::Refunded
                    : OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded,
            ]);

            $this->audit->handle($actor, 'order.partially_refunded', $order, [
                'amount' => $amount,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
                'gateway_refund_id' => $result->id,
            ]);

            return $refund;
        });

        // REFUND-INV-4: the customer is notified only after the commit.
        OrderRefunded::dispatch($order, $refund);

        return $refund;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Actions\Refunds\RefundOrderPartially;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StorePartialRefundRequest;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\PaymentGatewayException;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class OrderPartialRefundController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Order $order, StorePartialRefundRequest $request, RefundOrderPartially $refundPartially): RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $refundPartially->handle(
                $order,
                $request->user(),
                (int) $request->validated('amount'),
                $request->validated('reason'),
                $request->header('Idempotency-Key'),
            );
        } catch (PaymentGatewayException $e) {
            // The gateway refused (IdempotencyKeyReused included): nothing was written.
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['refund' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return to_route('admin.orders.show', $order)->with('status', 'Rimborso registrato.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Refunds;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordAuditEntry;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Events\OrderRefunded;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Refund;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use App\Payments\PaymentGateway;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Refunds part of a paid order, possibly in several steps, up to the order amount.
 *
 * Authorization (OrderPolicy::refund) is the caller's job, as for the other Actions.
 *
 * @contract docs/contracts/refunds.partial.md
 */
final class RefundOrderPartially
{
    public function __construct(
        private PaymentGateway $gateway,
        private RecordAuditEntry $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  int  $amount  cents
     *
     * @throws ValidationException when the amount is not positive or exceeds the refundable balance
     * @throws IdempotencyKeyReused when the key was already used on this order with another amount
     */
    public function handle(Order $order, User $actor, int $amount, string $reason, string $idempotencyKey): Refund
    {
        // REFUND-INV-5: a replay returns the refund already recorded, without writing anything.
        if ($existing = $order->refunds()->firstWhere('idempotency_key', $idempotencyKey)) {
            if ($existing->amountInCents() !== $amount) {
                throw new IdempotencyKeyReused($idempotencyKey);
            }

            return $existing;
        }

        // REFUND-INV-2: never beyond the refundable balance, checked before the gateway.
        $refundable = $order->refundableCents();

        if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $refundable) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'amount' => "L'importo deve essere compreso fra 1 e {$refundable} centesimi.",
            ]);
        }

        // Before the transaction, with the client's key as is (REFUND-INV-5).
        $result = $this->gateway->refund($order->gateway_charge_id, $amount, $idempotencyKey);

        $refund = DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $actor, $amount, $reason, $idempotencyKey, $result) {
            $refund = $order->refunds()->create([
                'amount' => Refund::centsToEuros($amount),
                'gateway_refund_id' => $result->id,
                'refunded_by' => $actor->id,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
            ]);

            // ORDER-INV-1, compared in cents.
            $order->update([
                'status' => $order->refundedCents() >= $order->amount
                    ? OrderStatus::Refunded
                    : OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded,
            ]);

            $this->audit->handle($actor, 'order.partially_refunded', $order, [
                'amount' => $amount,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
                'gateway_refund_id' => $result->id,
            ]);

            return $refund;
        });

        // REFUND-INV-4: the customer is notified only after the commit.
        OrderRefunded::dispatch($order, $refund);

        return $refund;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * Shape of a partial refund request. The refundable balance is checked by the Action
 * (RefundOrderPartially), authorization by the controller (OrderPolicy::refund).
 */
class StorePartialRefundRequest extends FormRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'amount' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1'],
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Actions\Refunds\RefundOrderPartially;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StorePartialRefundRequest;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\PaymentGatewayException;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class OrderPartialRefundController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Order $order, StorePartialRefundRequest $request, RefundOrderPartially $refundPartially): RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $refundPartially->handle(
                $order,
                $request->user(),
                (int) $request->validated('amount'),
                $request->validated('reason'),
                $request->header('Idempotency-Key'),
            );
        } catch (PaymentGatewayException $e) {
            // The gateway refused (IdempotencyKeyReused included): nothing was written.
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['refund' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return to_route('admin.orders.show', $order)->with('status', 'Rimborso registrato.');
    }
}

<?php

use App\Actions\Refunds\RefundOrderPartially;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Events\OrderRefunded;
use App\Models\AuditEntry;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Refund;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RefundIssued;
use App\Payments\Exceptions\IdempotencyKeyReused;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->payments = $this->fakePayments();
});

function refundPartially(Order $order, User $actor, int $amount, string $key, string $reason = 'Articolo danneggiato')
{
    return test()->actingAs($actor)
        ->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
        ->postJson("/admin/orders/{$order->id}/refunds", ['amount' => $amount, 'reason' => $reason]);
}

// REFUND-INV-1

it('lets finance and admin refund part of an order', function (string $role) {
    $actor = User::factory()->{$role}()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 5000]);

    refundPartially($order, $actor, 1250, 'key-1')
        ->assertRedirect("/admin/orders/{$order->id}")
        ->assertSessionHas('status', 'Rimborso registrato.');

    $refund = Refund::sole();
    expect($refund->amount)->toBe('12.50')
        ->and($refund->reason)->toBe('Articolo danneggiato')
        ->and($refund->refunded_by)->toBe($actor->id)
        ->and($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded);

    $this->payments->assertRefunded($order->gateway_charge_id, 1250);
})->with(['finance', 'admin'])->group('REFUND-INV-1', 'ORDER-INV-1');

it('forbids support and customers from refunding part of an order', function (string $role) {
    $actor = User::factory()->{$role}()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->for($role === 'customer' ? $actor : User::factory())->create(['amount' => 5000]);

    refundPartially($order, $actor, 1000, 'key-1')->assertForbidden();

    // Even with an invalid body, authorization comes first.
    refundPartially($order, $actor, -5, 'key-2')->assertForbidden();

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(AuditEntry::count())->toBe(0)
        ->and($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Paid);
    $this->payments->assertNothingRefunded();
})->with(['support', 'customer'])->group('REFUND-INV-1');

// REFUND-INV-2

it('refunds in several steps up to the order amount', function () {
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'key-1')->assertRedirect();
    expect($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1990, 'key-2')->assertRedirect();
    expect($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 10, 'key-3')->assertRedirect();
    expect($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Refunded)
        ->and($order->fresh()->refundedCents())->toBe(3000)
        ->and($order->refunds()->pluck('amount')->all())->toBe(['10.00', '19.90', '0.10']);
})->group('REFUND-INV-2', 'ORDER-INV-1');

it('rejects an amount beyond the refundable balance without calling the gateway', function () {
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 2000, 'key-1')->assertRedirect();
    $this->payments = $this->fakePayments(); // fresh fake: count calls from here

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1001, 'key-2')
        ->assertUnprocessable()
        ->assertJsonValidationErrors('amount');

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(AuditEntry::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded);
    $this->payments->assertNothingRefunded();
})->group('REFUND-INV-2');

it('rejects invalid amounts and a missing reason', function (array $body, string $field) {
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->finance()->create())
        ->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', 'key-1')
        ->postJson("/admin/orders/{$order->id}/refunds", $body)
        ->assertUnprocessable()
        ->assertJsonValidationErrors($field);

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(0);
    $this->payments->assertNothingRefunded();
})->with([
    'zero' => [['amount' => 0, 'reason' => 'x'], 'amount'],
    'negative' => [['amount' => -100, 'reason' => 'x'], 'amount'],
    'not an integer' => [['amount' => 12.5, 'reason' => 'x'], 'amount'],
    'missing amount' => [['reason' => 'x'], 'amount'],
    'missing reason' => [['amount' => 100], 'reason'],
])->group('REFUND-INV-2');

it('does not refund orders that are not paid or partially refunded', function (string $state) {
    $order = Order::factory()->{$state}()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, User::factory()->admin()->create(), 100, 'key-1')->assertForbidden();

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(0);
    $this->payments->assertNothingRefunded();
})->with(['refunded', 'cancelled', 'pending' => 'createQuietly'])->group('REFUND-INV-2');

// REFUND-INV-3 + REFUND-INV-4

it('writes nothing and notifies nobody when a write fails', function () {
    Notification::fake();
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    DB::unprepared("CREATE TRIGGER fail_audit BEFORE INSERT ON audit_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit unavailable'); END;");

    expect(fn () => app(RefundOrderPartially::class)->handle($order, $finance, 1000, 'Test', 'key-1'))
        ->toThrow(QueryException::class, 'audit unavailable');

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(0)
        ->and($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Paid);
    Notification::assertNothingSent();

    // The client retries with the same key: one refund at the gateway, writes completed.
    DB::unprepared('DROP TRIGGER fail_audit');

    app(RefundOrderPartially::class)->handle($order->fresh(), $finance, 1000, 'Test', 'key-1');

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::PartiallyRefunded)
        ->and($this->payments->refundsFor($order->gateway_charge_id))->toHaveCount(1);
    Notification::assertSentTo($order->user, RefundIssued::class);
})->group('REFUND-INV-3', 'REFUND-INV-4', 'REFUND-INV-5');

it('notifies the customer only after the transaction commits', function () {
    Notification::fake();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);
    $levelBefore = DB::transactionLevel();
    $levelsAtDispatch = [];

    Event::listen(OrderRefunded::class, function () use (&$levelsAtDispatch) {
        $levelsAtDispatch[] = DB::transactionLevel();
    });

    app(RefundOrderPartially::class)->handle($order, User::factory()->finance()->create(), 500, 'Test', 'key-1');

    expect($levelsAtDispatch)->toBe([$levelBefore]);
    Notification::assertSentTo($order->user, RefundIssued::class);
})->group('REFUND-INV-4');

// REFUND-INV-5

it('refunds once when the same Idempotency-Key is repeated', function () {
    Notification::fake();
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'same-key')->assertRedirect();
    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'same-key')->assertRedirect();

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(AuditEntry::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and($order->fresh()->refundedCents())->toBe(1000)
        ->and($this->payments->refundsFor($order->gateway_charge_id))->toHaveCount(1);
    Notification::assertSentToTimes($order->user, RefundIssued::class, 1);
})->group('REFUND-INV-5');

it('treats different keys as distinct refunds, even with the same amount', function () {
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'key-a')->assertRedirect();
    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'key-b')->assertRedirect();

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(2)
        ->and($this->payments->refundsFor($order->gateway_charge_id))->toHaveCount(2);
})->group('REFUND-INV-5');

it('passes the client key to the gateway as is', function () {
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, User::factory()->finance()->create(), 700, 'client-key-42')->assertRedirect();

    $refunds = $this->payments->refundsByKey();
    expect(array_keys($refunds))->toBe(['client-key-42'])
        ->and($refunds['client-key-42']->amount)->toBe(700);
})->group('REFUND-INV-5');

it('rejects the same key with a different amount', function () {
    $finance = User::factory()->finance()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $finance, 1000, 'same-key')->assertRedirect();
    refundPartially($order, $finance, 900, 'same-key')
        ->assertUnprocessable()
        ->assertJsonValidationErrors('refund');

    expect(fn () => app(RefundOrderPartially::class)->handle($order->fresh(), $finance, 900, 'Test', 'same-key'))
        ->toThrow(IdempotencyKeyReused::class);

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and($this->payments->refundsFor($order->gateway_charge_id))->toHaveCount(1);
})->group('REFUND-INV-5');

it('requires the Idempotency-Key header', function () {
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->finance()->create())
        ->postJson("/admin/orders/{$order->id}/refunds", ['amount' => 100, 'reason' => 'x'])
        ->assertStatus(400);

    expect(Refund::count())->toBe(0);
    $this->payments->assertNothingRefunded();
})->group('REFUND-INV-5');

// REFUND-INV-6

it('records actor, reason, idempotency key and gateway refund id in the audit', function () {
    $admin = User::factory()->admin()->create();
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3000]);

    refundPartially($order, $admin, 1500, 'key-audit', 'Spedizione in ritardo')->assertRedirect();

    $refund = Refund::sole();
    $entry = AuditEntry::sole();
    expect($entry->action)->toBe('order.partially_refunded')
        ->and($entry->actor_id)->toBe($admin->id)
        ->and($entry->subject->is($order))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($entry->payload)->toMatchArray([
            'amount' => 1500,
            'reason' => 'Spedizione in ritardo',
            'idempotency_key' => 'key-audit',
            'gateway_refund_id' => $refund->gateway_refund_id,
        ]);
})->group('REFUND-INV-6');

// The legacy full refund keeps working next to the partial one.

it('keeps the legacy full refund working', function () {
    $order = Order::factory()->paid()->create(['amount' => 3200]);

    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->support()->create())
        ->post("/admin/orders/{$order->id}/refund")
        ->assertRedirect();

    expect($order->fresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Refunded);
    $this->payments->assertRefunded($order->gateway_charge_id, 3200);
});

Revisione umana; poi, fuori da T-001: aggiornare `docs/contracts/INDEX.md` (classe `RefundOrderPartially` al posto di "da creare") e `docs/glossary.md` (stato `partially_refunded`, rimborso parziale esistente). - Il middleware `idempotent` richiede un header: un form HTML del back office non può inviarlo. Nessun form per il parziale nella vista (fuori scope).

## Rischi aperti

- Concorrenza: il saldo rimborsabile si controlla prima del gateway, senza lock; due richieste parallele con chiavi diverse possono superare `orders.amount`. Non testato.
- Replay con la stessa chiave dopo che quel rimborso ha portato l'ordine a `refunded`: la Policy risponde 403 invece di restituire il rimborso esistente (nessun doppio rimborso, ma non è il "restituisce quello esistente" del contract).
- `PaymentGatewayException` (anche `IdempotencyKeyReused`) diventa 422 con errore `refund`: scelta mia, il contract dice solo "torna al client".
- `down()` della migrazione fallisce se esistono più rimborsi per ordine.

content.text:
Ora dal back office si può fare un rimborso parziale: `finance` e `admin` rimborsano una parte di un ordine, anche in più volte, fino all'importo totale. Il rimborso totale esistente funziona come prima. Passano tutti i test: i 6 gruppi REFUND-INV-1..6 e l'intera suite (46/46), compresi i test del rimborso totale, che non ho toccato.

## Come funziona
- **Rotta:** `POST /admin/orders/{order}/refunds` con `amount` (centesimi), `reason` e l'header `Idempotency-Key`, obbligatorio: senza risponde 400.
- **Autorizzazione:** decide `OrderPolicy::refund` e viene controllata prima della validazione, quindi `support` e i clienti ricevono 403 anche se mandano dati non validi.
- **Validazione:** `amount` deve essere maggiore di 0 e non superare quanto resta da rimborsare, altrimenti 422 e il gateway non viene chiamato.
- **Ordine delle operazioni:** prima la chiamata al gateway con la chiave del client, poi in una sola transazione la riga del rimborso (in euro, come il resto della colonna), lo stato dell'ordine e la riga di audit. La notifica al cliente parte solo dopo il commit.
- **Stato dell'ordine:** diventa `partially_refunded` finché resta un saldo e `refunded` quando la somma arriva al totale. Ho aggiunto questo stato all'enum `OrderStatus` e la Policy ora accetta ordini `paid` o `partially_refunded`.
- **Richieste ripetute:** con la stessa chiave non si rimborsa né si scrive due volte e torna il rimborso già registrato. La stessa chiave con un importo diverso dà errore; due chiavi diverse sono due rimborsi.
- **Migrazione nuova** (`2026_11_13_100000_add_partial_refunds_to_refunds_table.php`, già approvata nel contract): toglie il vincolo "un solo rimborso per ordine" e aggiunge le colonne `reason` e `idempotency_key`. È solo additiva e le migrazioni esistenti sono intatte. Non l'ho ancora lanciata su `database/database.sqlite`: gira solo nel database in memoria dei test.

Il codice nuovo sta in `app/Actions/Refunds/RefundOrderPartially.php`, `app/Http/Requests/StorePartialRefundRequest.php`, `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/OrderPartialRefundController.php` e `tests/Feature/Refunds/PartialRefundTest.php`. Ho modificato anche `Order` e `Refund` (conversione centesimi/euro e saldo rimborsabile), `OrderPolicy` e `routes/web.php`.

## Verifica
